Kingston FURY Beast DDR5 16GB 6000MT/s CL36 Specifications

​The Kingston FURY Beast DDR5 is a high-performance memory module designed for the latest gaming platforms (Intel Z690/Z790 and AMD 600 series). It brings the extreme speed of DDR5 technology with enhanced stability for overclocking, featuring a low-profile heat spreader design.

​Core Specifications

  • ​Capacity: 16GB (Single Module)
  • ​Memory Type: DDR5
  • ​Speed: 6000MT/s (PC5-48000)
  • ​Latency: CL36 (36-38-38)
  • ​Voltage: 1.35V
  • ​Operating Temperature: 0°C to 85°C

​Technical Features

  • ​On-Die ECC (ODECC): Improved stability at extreme speeds by correcting data errors directly within the RAM chip.
  • ​Dual 32-bit Subchannels: Increased efficiency and data handling compared to DDR4.
  • ​Power Management IC (PMIC): Built-in circuit to regulate power more effectively and reduce heat.
  • ​Profiles: * Intel® XMP 3.0 Certified: Pre-optimized timings, speeds, and voltages for easy overclocking.
    • ​AMD EXPO™ Support: Optimized for AMD Ryzen 7000/8000/9000 series platforms.

​Physical Design

  • ​Heat Spreader: Low-profile black aluminum heat spreader.
  • ​Height: 34.9 mm (Excellent clearance for large CPU air coolers).
  • ​Pins: 288-pin DIMM.

​Key Highlights

  • ​High-Speed Performance: At 6000MT/s, this RAM provides a massive bandwidth jump over standard DDR4, ideal for gaming, video editing, and heavy multitasking.
  • ​Plug N Play: Features automatic overclocking to the highest listed speed allowed by the system BIOS.
  • ​Stability: The combination of On-Die ECC and PMIC ensures that even during intense gaming sessions, the system remains stable and reliable.
  • ​Broad Compatibility: Tested and approved to work with the world's leading motherboard manufacturers (ASUS, MSI, Gigabyte, ASRock).
